name: OpenThai
description: Thai open-model project running a free hosted API at api.aieat.or.th.
overview: OpenThai (formerly OpenThaiGPT) is the Thai AI association's open-model project, and it runs a free hosted inference endpoint at api.aieat.or.th that needs no account and no payment — the published examples send a literal placeholder as the bearer token. The served model is OpenThaiGPT 1.5 7B, a Qwen 2.5 derivative tuned for Thai, also reachable through Float16.cloud's dedicated endpoint. It is a community research service: rate-limited, no SLA, and best treated as a Thai-language fallback rather than production capacity.
free_access: Free hosted endpoint with no signup and no card
Run by a non-profit association, not a vendor
notes: Community-run and rate-limited with no published quota. The 72B and Legal 30B variants are weights-only; the hosted demo keys are shared placeholders, so expect contention.
